payload.title: Continuous uncertainty-conditioned E011 placement
payload.statement: Legal continuous uncertainty features may identify when a bounded blend or exact fallback from E011 toward E006 reduces catastrophic error more safely than hard regime specialists.
payload.evidence_for: Public participant evidence points to PF posterior spread and branch mass/separation as risk signals; exact public sources expose stochastic disagreement and branch statistics; E011 and E006 provide verified global paths with identical OOF membership.
payload.evidence_against: E009 consensus uncertainty and E012 hard/local specialists failed transfer. E011 already improves every registered context, so fallback may have little learnable value and can easily discard a strong correction.
payload.next_test: Before E013 implementation, measure per-well oracle E011/E006 choice and continuous-blend headroom, prevalence/support, feature-target association, and at least three cross-fitted legal screening families across all 25 repeated cells with shuffled-label and exact-fallback controls. Close H016 if D022 worth thresholds fail.
